name: zdeclient_load_config_resources
description: zDEClient::LoadConfigResources loads declient.zrd, seeds crater and quick-sand template defaults, creates crater/quicksand materials, binds the camera node, frees the reader tree, and registers the zDEClient ZAR handler when rebuild-on-reload is enabled.
known_limits: VC5SP3 zdeclient_load_config_resources currently fails 0x4558f0 with 639 unmasked mismatches after 508 relocation bytes and 12 trimmed VC5 NOPs, BN size 1235 vs VC5 size 1248; 0x455dd0 is byte-clean in the same owner target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x4558f0 validates the declient.zrd load path, crater and quick-sand named-node reads, material and texture-directory calls, texture-pending flush, loaded-tree free, camera-node binding, and optional zDEClient ZAR handler registration.

The native smoke mounts a declient.zrd archive, exercises the real reader/material/effect/ZBD paths, and verifies crater defaults, quick-sand texture-cycle setup, camera globals, freed config root, and handler registration.
